newsitem.title: USA: GE's Welch approached Dow to settle - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: GE's Welch approached Dow to settle - WSJ.

text.p: General Electric Chairman John Welch approached Dow Chemical about settling a just-resolved dispute involving trade secrets, the Wall Street Journal said in Thursday's electronic edition.
On April 1, Dow Chemical filed a suit charging General Electric with systematically and aggressively targeting and hiring 14 Dow employees who were privy to trade secrets.
The companies said on Wednesday they resolved the dispute in a settlement involving no financial consideration.

According to people familiar with the matter, GE's Welch, who dislikes bad publicity, telephoned Dow Chemical Chairman William Stavropoulos immediately after the charges were announced to initiate settlement talks, the paper said.
